title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
abstract: arXiv:2611.06728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. translated_title: 回合至关重要：通过回合级信用分配推进流式视频强化学习
translated_abstract: 流式视频理解要求模型反复决定是应当立即回应还是继续观察。最近，组相对策略优化（GRPO）已被应用于这一场景，但现有方法侧重于奖励设计，同时在各回合之间保留单一的轨迹级优势。这种共享信用可能会在早期成功之后强化冗余回复，并在早期失败之后抑制有用的后续回应。我们提出TurnWise，一个回合级的GRPO框架，使学习与各个流式决策对齐。TurnWise解决了轨迹级反馈与回合级交互之间的不匹配问题，促进有信息量的回应并减少冗余。具体而言，回合级信用分配采用静默补全的前缀评分，从每个决策的剩余回报构建组相对优势，将其学习信号与先前的奖励分离开来。回合均值策略优化通过对……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TurnWise——一个回合级GRPO框架，通过基于静默补全前缀评分的回合级信用分配和回合均值策略优化，解决了流式视频强化学习中轨迹级反馈与回合级决策不匹配的问题，从而促进有信息量的回应并减少冗余回复。
en_tdlr: TurnWise is a turn-level GRPO framework that resolves the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level streaming decisions in video RL, using silence-completed prefix scoring for turn-level credit assignment and turn-mean policy optimization to promote informative responses and reduce redundancy.
